name: claude-mods
description: Personal Claude Code mods: turn notifications and a colored session status band

plugins.name: turn-notify
plugins.description: Toast and sound when Claude finishes a turn or needs your input

plugins.name: session-status
plugins.description: Two rows of Catppuccin Macchiato split pills above the prompt (solid icon, soft value; half-disc caps on every surface): work item (its Azure DevOps title on hover), git branch, active-time timer and subagent counts, then a context bar (token count on hover) and CPU/RAM/temperature (Windows only); plus a session title with the work item title (needs the Azure CLI, read-only)
